items.title: ANNOUNCEMENT
items.author: Admin
items.content:
[h3]LOOKING FOR STREAMERS[/h3]
- Para sa mga interested maging Streamer ng RAN Online EP9, kindly fill out the application form below. [br]
- Once ma-review ng admins at pasok ka sa aming criteria, we will reach out to you again for the next step.
[code]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdeM1RRx7Ec_aXaF2ANUV7ST9tAuacAwwb7Qj9a_l8sjHQvJQ/viewform[/code]
Thank you, mga Boss! [br]
